title: Research 2026-10-22
body: Studied the 10-21 digest (rules evidence: auto bets + bids, manual excluded). 1,424 settled, ROI -0.3%, CLV +1.5% (n 908). Team totals are the clear earner (+24.1% ROI, z +3.4, CLV +2.9%); NHL +9.9%; NCAAF +24.3%. Leaks: NBA -30.9% ROI (CLV -5.1%, only n 58), spreads -11.4% (CLV -1.8%, n 97), moneylines -34% (n 22). Engine orders: 617 total, 359 settled, ROI +13.5%; engine bids 270 settled +10.5% ROI. No setting changed: fewer than 100 new settled bets since the last analysis and no leak group has the 200+ CLV closes the rule gates need. Next: NBA and spreads leak (tighten when CLV n reaches 200), ParlayAPI spend split (CH57a) once the engine's hourly Spend lines from a full day are in. Engine: idle until 08:00 ET (correct); last scan 20 listed, 0 ordered (15 held by the 6 h trap guard, 5 stale other-book prices); 272 bids resting.
